english.title: Distribute feed for birds within Trafalgar Square
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Trafalgar Square, distributed feeding stuff for birds other than at the direction of the Mayor
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 4(1)(b) of the Trafalgar Square Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3)(b) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

distributed feed for birds

english.notes: (i) As per byelaw 4(2) the offence does not apply to authorised persons, members of the armed forces and any fire brigade or ambulance service acting in the performance of his duty when doing anything reasonably necessary for the performance of that duty.(ii) As per byelaw 9, where an authorised person has reasonable ground for belief that a person has contravened any one or more of the Byelaws, that person shall give on demand his name and address to that authorised person.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, within Trafalgar Square, distributed feeding stuff for birds other than at the direction of the Mayor.
